description:
Indoor market in Portugal. 
I made this recording in an indoor market near Faro, Algarve, Portugal. 
You can hear vendors and customers talking, and not so fare, a butcher cuts some meat. 
Recorded in June 2018, with an Olympus LS-3 (internal microphones, TRESMIC ON). 
Fade in/out and high pass filter 160Hz -6dB/oct applied in Audacity.
name: LS_33988_POR_IndoorMarket.wav
